title: NBA: Blazers snap Sixers streak, Thunder stumble
summary: Deni Avdija scored 31 points as the Portland Trail Blazers snapped the Philadelphia 76ers' five-game winning streak with a dominant 128-111 road victory in the NBA on Monday.
